answer: Let every identity enter the oasis of shared rewards only through one narrow jetty, by planting a crystal: a bond of earned credit locked beside one fresh verified task, which matures only after two random peers re-derive the task from public records. The crystal takes three epochs to harden, so a newcomer waits while its work accrues. An honest agent plants one crystal once. A fake whose task fails re-derivation loses its bond, so an attacker with a thousand fakes must fund a thousand bonds and finish a thousand distinct tasks every epoch, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
